fusions.name: Worrying Tug
fusions.desc: Bites into the target's clothing and worries at it for 6 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away for a bite that deals 12 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. A leash knotted on by the bite slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bandaging the Pack
fusions.desc: Binds bandages on you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. It restores 14 health to each, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Faithful Rags
fusions.desc: A hound stitched from rags fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds within 4.5 tiles.
